messages:
mari: Heads-up — headroom doc says cutoff for this minor (v1.12.x) is in ~6h. We need version bumps and changelog entries across: api, runtime, console, js-sdk, py-sdk. Who's owning which repo?

kevin: I can take runtime. I'll open the bump PR and include the changelog snippet. ETA ~2h.

anya: taking js-sdk. Quick question — do we bump semver in package.json only, or also write a CHANGELOG.md entry in the repo?

mari: both please. Changelog should include short bullet: what changed + migration notes if any. Use the template in ops/docs/changelog-template.md.

sam: I'll do api. I have an open feature PR that needs merging before bumping — if it doesn't land I'll cut a followup bump. Will ping after CI.

jen: py-sdk here. I need the exact version number we plan to release. Is it 1.12.0?

mari: yes, 1.12.0 for the minor. If any repo has breaking changes, call it out and we can do 1.12.0-rc then iterate.

kevin: opening runtime PR now: https://git.redwood/d/runtime/pulls/678 — includes version bump + changelog. CI kicked off.

release-bot: CI status for PR 678: checks queued → running.

anya: js-sdk PR: https://git.redwood/d/js-sdk/pulls/145 — bump to 1.12.0, added CHANGELOG.md entry. Need review from @kevin for the build matrix change.

kevin: reviewing now. small comment on matrix order.

sam: api PR: https://git.redwood/d/api/pulls/912 — bumped, but blocked by one failing integration test (auth mock flake). Trying a rerun.

release-bot: CI rerun for PR 912 requested by sam — queued.

mari: if auth mock flakes, we can relax the assertion for now and open a followup patch post-cut. But prefer to keep tests green. Sam, if it doesn't clear in 1h, mark as followup and we'll still cut others.

jen: py-sdk PR: https://git.redwood/d/py-sdk/pulls/73 — bumped and uploaded wheels to staging. Test matrix passed on 3.9/3.10. Need a quick owner ok for publishing keys.

mari: @jen — I'll do a quick key sanity check in 20m. Also remind folks to include the `RELEASE_NOTES.md` entry in root.

anya: one more detail — runtime bump will change the default quant profile name. I added a migration note in changelog but also posted a short snippet in the runtime README.

kevin: saw it. Good call. Also adding a small automated migration script: `scripts/update-default-quant.sh` — please run on deploy nodes during rollout.

mari: plan for cut: start tagging in this order to avoid dependency issues: runtime -> api -> js-sdk -> py-sdk -> console. We'll wait for green CI and successful artifact publish before tagging dependent repos.

sam: API tests are green now. PR 912 merged. Tagging when runtime is green.

release-bot: PR 912 merged by sam at 1802504510.

kevin: runtime CI passed. Merged PR 678. Tagging runtime as v1.12.0 now: git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "runtime v1.12.0" && git push origin v1.12.0

release-bot: PR 678 merged by kevin at 1802504622. Artifact published to internal registry.

mari: good — api and runtime tagged. Next js-sdk then py-sdk. @anya make sure the package publish includes the new dist tag.

anya: publishing js-sdk now. npm publish --tag latest -> success. URL: https://npm.redwood/js-sdk/v/1.12.0

jen: py-sdk published to pypi-staging and promoted to prod. wheels available.

release-bot: js-sdk 1.12.0 published at 1802504690. py-sdk 1.12.0 published at 1802504718.

mari: console bump — console repo has a small dependency on js-sdk pinned to ^1.11.0; we need to update the lockfile. Who can take console?

kevin: I can update console lockfile quickly and run smoke.

kevin: console PR: https://git.redwood/d/console/pulls/201 — updates lockfile and bump, added CHANGELOG. Smoke passes locally.

sam: I'll approve after CI.

release-bot: PR 201 CI passed.

sam: LGTM, merging console PR now. Tagging console v1.12.0.

release-bot: console v1.12.0 tagged and deployed to staging at 1802504785.

mari: all set — everything bumped and tagged. Great cross-repo coordination, team. Followups: sam to open a ticket for the auth mock flake root cause, kevin to land migration script into ops, anya to confirm SDK telemetry after publish. I'll update the release tracker and send the release announcement draft in #announcements for review. :tada:

kevin: noted — will open PR for migration script into ops in the next sprint.

anya: checking telemetry now, will report back if anything odd.

jen: thanks everyone.

mari: closing this thread — reach out if you see post-release regressions and we'll roll forward/fallback as needed. :shipit:
